produced_by.game: Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfect Edition
produced_by.notes:
**Saint Seiya: Ougon Densetsu Hen Perfect Edition** is a 2003 WonderSwan Color game by Bandai, a remake of the 1987 Famicom game, released only in Japan. This is a **Brazilian Portuguese** version of the English translation v0.9.6, made at the request of a Brazilian player. It uses the names of the Brazilian dub, *Os Cavaleiros do Zodíaco*: Cavaleiros, Armaduras, Atena, Grande Mestre, Mestre Ancião, Máscara da Morte, Aioria, Miro, Afrodite, Meteoro de Pégaso, Cólera do Dragão, Pó de Diamante...

**v0.1 is a test version for review:** it has not been checked by a native speaker yet. The CSV in the zip has every line in Japanese, English and Portuguese, with the space available for each one.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play. It must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply one of the .bps patches to *Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfect Edition (Japan).wsc* (2 MB, CRC32 6E8A792D) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. Keep the .wsc extension.

* Normal: `Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfect Edition (PT-BR v0.1).bps`, result CRC32 09AED7EA.
* ALL CAPS: `Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfect Edition (PT-BR v0.1, ALL CAPS).bps`, result CRC32 EB54FFA4.
